mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 67 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Fireman's Park, plus we have a Full Moon shining bright.

The City of Verona is launching an eighteen-month project to update the Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term guide for growth and development. You can find more details and participate in the process by visiting the Envision Verona project website.

There is so much happening today! You can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, visit the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, attend a yoga session at Insight Wellness, grab pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or participate in Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In our police report for the week, on August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road regarding a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
